name: inbox.meta_receive
description: Keeps the comments and DMs Meta's webhook brought for one account linked through our own Meta app: each lands in the inbox of the brand that holds the account, once, and one the person deleted on the platform is deleted here too (Platform Terms §3.d.i.2) (Meta sends again after a failure; the message's id is made from Meta's own). An account no brand within reach holds is refused as not found. Internal: packages/connect's webhook calls it as the principal META_WEBHOOK_AS names.
sql: with a as (select a.brand_id from brandbase.accounts a where a.platform = :platform and a.account_id = :account and a.details ->> 'via' = 'meta'), ins as (insert into brandbase.inbox_messages (id, brand_id, platform, kind, from_name, from_handle, text, received_at, tone, external) select x.id, a.brand_id, case :platform when 'instagram' then 'ig' else 'fb' end, x.kind, x."fromName", x."fromHandle", x.text, x."receivedAt"::timestamptz, 'question', x.external from a, jsonb_to_recordset(:items::jsonb) as x(id text, kind text, "fromName" text, "fromHandle" text, text text, "receivedAt" text, external jsonb) on conflict (id) do nothing returning 1), del as (delete from brandbase.inbox_messages m using a where m.brand_id = a.brand_id and m.external is not null and m.id in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(:removed::jsonb)) returning 1) select jsonb_build_object('brand', (select brand_id from a), 'stored', (select count(*) from ins), 'removed', (select count(*) from del)) as result
